Shen.fight: Poke with Jayce Q Shock Blast in cannon form, and counterattack if Shen E Shadow Dash misses. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, save your basic attacks and deal damage with abilities. If you get on Shen, knock him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow and trade briefly.
Shen.laning: In the early game, take control by disrupting Shen's last hits with Jayce Q Shock Blast in cannon form. Pressure him near the center instead of always pushing the lane all the way in. When Shen R Stand United can take him to another lane, push the wave so leaving costs him something. If Shen leaves with Shen R Stand United, alert your team and take advantage of the empty lane.
Shen.phase: In the early to mid game, turn that lead into lane and objective advantages. In late-game team fights, Jayce is vulnerable if caught, so watch out especially for Shen E Shadow Dash.
Shen.teamfight: Start fights from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast and keep enough distance to dodge Shen E Shadow Dash. If Shen looks ready to join another fight with Shen R Stand United, alert your team immediately. Only when the enemy formation is disrupted, switch to Jayce R Mercury Hammer, go in briefly, then switch to cannon and disengage.
Shen.watch: If you're hit by Shen E Shadow Dash, you'll take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault while taunted, so avoid the dash path. Also move out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault's returning spirit blade. Shen W Spirit's Refuge nullifies Jayce's basic attacks, so stop attacking and keep your distance while inside it.

Singed.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Singed's main damage is magic, so raise your magic resistance first. If Singed's crowd control puts you in danger, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Singed.combo: In cannon form, fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through Jayce E Acceleration Gate as soon as you place it. When you can close in and finish him, use Jayce Q Shock Blast → Jayce R Mercury Hammer → Jayce Q To the Skies! → basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field → Jayce E Thundering Blow. Calculate the direction of the final knockback so you don't push Singed somewhere you can't safely chase him.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window to engage is after Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down. Make sure there's no adhesive underfoot, then engage with Jayce Q To the Skies!. If adhesive is down, you can't dash out of it, so don't engage over it.
Singed.fight: Keep your distance from Singed and poke with Jayce Q Shock Blast fired through Jayce E Acceleration Gate. Avoid Singed W Mega Adhesive and trade briefly at close range when Singed E Fling is down. Don't extend fights while following Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.laning: Keep the lane near the center and disrupt his last hits in cannon form. If Singed gets close, switch with Jayce R Mercury Hammer to gain resistances and push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes harder to kill once he has his core items, so turn your early and mid game lane advantage into objectives. In the late game, getting caught once is dangerous for Jayce, so fight while keeping your distance.
Singed.teamfight: Start teamfights from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast fired through Jayce E Acceleration Gate. Push back Singed when he runs at you with Jayce E Thundering Blow, and attack his allies instead of chasing him all the way. Only go in briefly when the enemy formation is disrupted, then switch to cannon and retreat.
Singed.watch: Don't chase Singed when his health is low while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. You can't dash with Jayce Q To the Skies! over Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around it. Singed E Fling throws you behind Singed, so don't stand in front of him when an enemy is behind him.

Sion.build: Sion's main damage is physical, and Jayce has low armor, so start by surviving with Cloth Armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots and prioritize armor. It's also important to dodge Sion E Roar of the Slayer, which reduces your armor when it hits.
Sion.combo: To poke, place Jayce E Acceleration Gate and immediately fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through it. If you can close in and finish him, hit with Jayce Q Shock Blast, switch with Jayce R Mercury Hammer, then engage with Jayce Q To the Skies! and use a basic attack, Jayce W Lightning Field, and Jayce E Thundering Blow in that order. Calculate the direction of Jayce E Thundering Blow so your chase isn't interrupted.
Sion.escape: Dodge the charge of Sion Q Decimating Smash or make him use it early, then close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies!. When you follow up with Jayce E Thundering Blow, choose the direction to push Sion.
Sion.fight: When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus your damage to break the shield before it explodes. After dodging the charge of Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side, poke with Jayce Q Shock Blast and switch to hammer for a short fight only when you can safely engage. If Sion approaches, switch with Jayce R Mercury Hammer to gain armor and push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Sion.laning: In cannon form, disrupt Sion's last hits with Jayce Q Shock Blast and keep the lane near the center. Sion's maximum health increases as he kills units, so don't keep letting him farm. If it's hard to deny his last hits, push the lane to disrupt his farming or use that time to gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.phase: In the mid game, turn that lead into objectives and don't let Sion keep gaining maximum health by farming CS. In late-game teamfights, getting caught once is dangerous for Jayce, so don't linger where enemies can engage.
Sion.teamfight: Start teamfights from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast, and watch the engage paths of Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Only go in briefly with a hammer combo when the enemy formation is disrupted, then switch with Jayce R Mercury Cannon and retreat. If Sion falls, keep your distance and reposition until Sion P Glory in Death ends.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash knocks you up and stuns you if he charges it, so dodge to the side when he starts charging. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught comes at you in almost a straight line, so avoid narrow paths and step aside. After Sion falls, Sion P Glory in Death revives him and lets him attack quickly, so immediately create distance.

Skarner.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots to raise your magic resistance. Skarner's main damage from P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale is magic damage. Skarner R Impale's suppression can't be reduced with resistances, so decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, place Jayce E Acceleration Gate in cannon form and immediately fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through it to hit him. To finish him, switch with Jayce R Mercury Hammer, engage with Jayce Q To the Skies!, then, immediately after switching forms, use a basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field → Jayce E Thundering Blow. Calculate the direction of Jayce E Thundering Blow so you don't push Skarner out of range mid-combo.
Skarner.escape: The moment after you make Skarner use E Ixtal's Impact is your window to engage. Close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies! and land Jayce E Thundering Blow. Conversely, if you let Skarner E Ixtal's Impact hit a wall, back off while accounting for his next dash.
Skarner.laning: In cannon form, disrupt Skarner's last hits with Jayce Q Shock Blast, but don't push the wave all the way; keep it near the center. Don't stand with your back to a wall so that even if Skarner E Ixtal's Impact catches you, it won't lead to a wall collision stun. Also use the movement speed from switching with Jayce R Mercury Hammer to maintain distance.
Skarner.phase: Jayce is strong early, when he can use both forms, so build a lead through lane advantage and objectives. Skarner's damage and durability both increase as he stacks defensive items, so delay his item timings in the early and mid game. In the late game, getting caught once is dangerous for Jayce, so keep your distance first.
Skarner.teamfight: Start teamfights from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast fired through Jayce E Acceleration Gate, and watch the engage range of Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and R Impale. Keep your distance from Skarner and his allies, and don't stand close to the edges of the Dragon or Baron pits. Only go in briefly when the enemy formation is disrupted to land a hammer combo, then switch back to cannon and retreat.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and stuns you when he slams you into a wall, making it easier for him to re-engage, so don't stand with your back to a wall. If Skarner R Impale catches you, you can't escape with Jayce Q To the Skies!, so keep your distance before you enter its range. Stay outside melee range so you don't keep getting hit by the empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.fight: Normally, poke with Jayce Q Shock Blast from outside the range of Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered attack. Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies!, knock him back with Jayce E Thundering Blow, and trade. If Skarner engages first, switch to Jayce R Mercury Hammer to gain armor and use Jayce E Thundering Blow to push him away.

TahmKench.build: Tahm Kench's main damage is magic, and Jayce has low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If a duel drags on because of the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin, fit Executioner's Calling into your build.
TahmKench.combo: To poke, place Jayce E Acceleration Gate in cannon form and immediately fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through it. If you can close in and finish him, hit with cannon-form Jayce Q Shock Blast, switch with Jayce R Mercury Hammer, then use Jayce Q To the Skies! → basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field → Jayce E Thundering Blow in that order. Calculate the direction of Jayce E Thundering Blow so you don't push Tahm Kench out of your range and interrupt the combo.
TahmKench.escape: After Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time engaging and escaping, so look for a chance to close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies! and deal all your damage at once. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks, don't go in; wait outside his range for the stacks to disappear.
TahmKench.fight: When Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has no stacks, poke in cannon form by placing Jayce E Acceleration Gate and immediately firing Jayce Q Shock Blast through it. Since Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn damage into a shield or healing, choose an opening that lets you deal all your damage at once when fighting up close. That opportunity comes when Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, making it harder for him to engage and escape.
TahmKench.laning: In cannon form, disrupt Tahm Kench's last hits with Jayce Q Shock Blast from outside his range, and keep the wave near the center. If you think Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks, back off and wait for them to disappear. If Tahm Kench gets close, switch with Jayce R Mercury Hammer, then fight back with Jayce Q To the Skies! and Jayce E Thundering Blow.
TahmKench.phase: In late-game teamfights, you're vulnerable if caught once, so poke first in cannon form and go in and out briefly. The available information isn't enough to determine when Tahm Kench is stronger than Jayce.
TahmKench.watch: Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash slows, stuns, and heals him, while Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive knocks up enemies in an area, so spread out from allies when you see him start the dive animation. Because Tahm Kench E Thick Skin provides a shield and healing, trades where you deal a little damage and back off are less effective.
TahmKench.teamfight: Apply pressure from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast, and spread out from allies when you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive so he can't knock up several people. Before attacking a carry Tahm Kench is protecting, check whether Tahm Kench R Devour is available. If an ally is swallowed, focus your damage on the slowed Tahm Kench; if an engage has occurred, switch with Jayce R Mercury Cannon and retreat.

Teemo.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. The damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap is mainly magic, so raise your magic resistance first.
Teemo.combo: In cannon form, place Jayce E Acceleration Gate and immediately fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through it. If it hits and Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, switch with Jayce R Mercury Hammer, then use Jayce Q To the Skies! → basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field → Jayce E Thundering Blow in that order. Use Jayce E Thundering Blow when you can push Teemo toward your chase path or a wall.
Teemo.escape: Engaging when Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down lets you avoid having your basic attacks blocked by the blind. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed but has no separate mobility ability, so close the gap, engage with Jayce Q To the Skies!, and push him with Jayce E Thundering Blow to continue the chase.
Teemo.fight: Take the moment after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down as your chance to trade. Poke first with cannon-form Jayce E Acceleration Gate and Jayce Q Shock Blast; if you decide to engage, commit all the way with Jayce Q To the Skies! so you don't just take a poisoned basic attack and back off. While blinded, fight with abilities such as Jayce Q To the Skies! and Jayce W Lightning Field instead of basic attacks.
Teemo.laning: In cannon form, disrupt Teemo's last hits with Jayce Q Shock Blast and keep the lane near the center. Don't simply walk past visionless bushes where Teemo could be hidden by Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare. After building an early lead, push the lane and pressure Teemo with your allied jungler.
Teemo.phase: In the mid game, turn that lead into objectives to reduce the time Teemo has to place Teemo R Noxious Trap. In late-game teamfights, Jayce is vulnerable if caught, so poke from the back and keep your engages brief.
Teemo.teamfight: Start teamfights from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast fired through Jayce E Acceleration Gate. Only engage with hammer for a brief attack when the enemy formation is disrupted, then switch to cannon and retreat. Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and narrow corridors, and watch familiar shortcuts when retreating too.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so use abilities instead of basic attacks or back off while blinded. Even one hit from Teemo E Toxic Shot's basic attack inflicts ongoing poison damage, so stay outside its range if you aren't ready to engage. Teemo R Noxious Trap is hidden and slows you, so be careful around objectives and when passing through narrow corridors.

Trundle.build: Trundle's main damage is physical, and Jayce has low armor, so start by surviving with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If Trundle P King's Tribute restores the health you took off with poke, fit Executioner's Calling into your build.
Trundle.combo: To poke, place Jayce E Acceleration Gate and immediately fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through it. To engage, hit with cannon-form Jayce Q Shock Blast, switch with Jayce R Mercury Cannon/Mercury Hammer, then engage with Jayce Q To the Skies! and use a basic attack, Jayce W Lightning Field, and Jayce E Thundering Blow in that order. Calculate the direction of the final knockback to push Trundle away.
Trundle.escape: The window to engage comes after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you have backed out of Trundle W Frozen Domain. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Jayce Q To the Skies! then and choose the direction for Jayce E Thundering Blow to push him.
Trundle.fight: In cannon form, poke by chaining Jayce E Acceleration Gate and Jayce Q Shock Blast in quick succession. Don't take fights inside Trundle W Frozen Domain. If Trundle gets close, switch to hammer to gain armor, then push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow. Take a short engage when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you get a chance to catch him outside W Frozen Domain.
Trundle.laning: Keep the lane near the center and poke Trundle when he goes for last hits with cannon-form Jayce Q Shock Blast. Trundle P King's Tribute heals him whenever a nearby unit dies, so don't leave him low on health and let the lane drag on. If your poke succeeds, take an advantage immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.phase: In the late game, getting caught once is dangerous for Jayce, so fight while keeping your distance.
Trundle.teamfight: Start teamfights from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast, and avoid narrow paths where Trundle E Pillar of Ice can easily block your escape. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance or attack another target. Only go in briefly with hammer when the enemy formation is disrupted, then switch to cannon and retreat.
Trundle.watch: Trundle gains attack speed, movement speed, and increased healing received inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, so back out and let it expire. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape and slows you, so avoid narrow paths and immediately move to the side when the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, he steals your resistances and becomes tanky, so create distance.

Tryndamere.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust restores the health you poke away, work Executioner's Calling into your build.
Tryndamere.combo: When poking, cast Jayce Q Shock Blast through Jayce E Acceleration Gate as soon as you place the gate. If Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down and you have a chance to finish him, hit Jayce Q Shock Blast, switch to Jayce R Mercury Hammer, then close in with Jayce Q To the Skies! and use basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field → Jayce E Thundering Blow. Plan which way to knock Tryndamere with the final knockback.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after you bait out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, you have an opening to go in with Jayce Q To the Skies! If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout is also down, you can close the gap without worrying about its slow. But if Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop your engage and wait it out.
Tryndamere.fight: Right after you bait out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, you have a chance to close the gap and trade as Jayce. In Cannon stance, poke first with Jayce E Acceleration Gate and Jayce Q Shock Blast. If he gets on top of you, switch to Hammer and knock him back with Jayce E Thundering Blow. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t spend more damage; create distance, wait it out, then attack again.
Tryndamere.laning: In the early game, use Jayce Q Shock Blast in Cannon stance to disrupt Tryndamere’s last hits, limiting both his Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. Keep the wave near the center, and create distance when Tryndamere starts building Fury by attacking minions so you’re ready for his dash. If he gets on top of you with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, switch to Hammer, hold your ground, and push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Tryndamere.phase: Jayce is strong early when he can use both forms, so build a lane advantage through poke and disrupting last hits. In the mid game, convert that advantage into objectives. In the late game, Jayce is vulnerable if caught, so keep Tryndamere E Spinning Slash’s engage range in mind and trade briefly before backing off.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Start the team fight from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast fired through Jayce E Acceleration Gate. If Tryndamere comes in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, knock him back with Jayce E Thundering Blow. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance and wait it out. Go in briefly with Hammer only when the enemy formation is disrupted, then switch to Cannon and back away.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere P Battle Fury stacks up, his critical strikes become dangerous. Tryndamere Q Bloodlust restores health, so create distance before he can build Fury by attacking minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a dash, and its cooldown is reduced each time he critically strikes, so don’t fight for long where there are lots of minions. When backing away to avoid Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing him. If it hits you, don’t immediately commit to a basic attack trade. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can’t be killed, so knock him back with Jayce E Thundering Blow, create distance, and wait it out.

Udyr.build: In the early game, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Udyr's damage is mainly physical and Jayce has low armor, so raise your armor first. If Udyr withstands your poke with healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle, fit Executioner's Calling into your build.
Udyr.combo: To poke, place Jayce E Acceleration Gate in cannon form and immediately fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through it. To engage, hit with cannon-form Jayce Q Shock Blast, switch with Jayce R Mercury Hammer, then use Jayce Q To the Skies! → basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field → Jayce E Thundering Blow in that order. Calculate the direction of the final knockback to push Udyr away.
Udyr.escape: The moment after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down is your chance to close in, so use Jayce Q To the Skies! to close the gap. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once, counterattack or retreat while he can't apply it to the same target again for a while. Immobilizing effects don't work during Udyr E Blazing Stampede's empowered state, so wait until it ends before interrupting him with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Udyr.fight: Before Udyr gets close, chip away at his health with Jayce Q Shock Blast in cannon form, but save Jayce E Thundering Blow to interrupt his engage. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, press your attack without giving him time to heal. When a melee trade starts, switch to hammer to gain armor and push Udyr away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Udyr.laning: Keep the lane near the center and disrupt Udyr's last hits by firing Jayce Q Shock Blast in cannon form from outside his engage range. Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so keep vision at key paths and jungle entrances, and don't move forward when he's out of sight. Save Jayce E Thundering Blow so you can escape if he gets close.
Udyr.phase: In late-game teamfights, Jayce has trouble fighting if caught once, so pay particular attention to the engage range of Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Udyr.teamfight: Start the fight from the back with cannon-form Jayce Q Shock Blast, and only go in briefly when the enemy formation is disrupted. Rather than pouring damage into Udyr, who has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle, target a weaker enemy behind him first. If you land a hammer combo, switch back to cannon and retreat immediately.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede increases his movement speed as he approaches and stuns with his first attack, so create distance right after he activates the stance. Udyr R Wingborne Storm slows and deals damage based on maximum health, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw also deals damage based on maximum health. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield and healing can erase your poke damage.

Urgot.build: In the early game, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Urgot's main damage is physical and Jayce has low armor, so raise your armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with maximum health, so avoid choices that greatly increase health alone.
Urgot.combo: In cannon form, place Jayce E Thundering Blow/Acceleration Gate and immediately fire Jayce Q To the Skies!/Shock Blast through the gate. If Urgot E Disdain is down and you can engage, land cannon Q, switch with Jayce R Mercury Cannon/Mercury Hammer, then trade briefly with hammer Q leap → basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field/Hyper Charge → hammer E knockback in that order.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so the moment after you make him use it is your chance to engage. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge also misses, close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies!/Shock Blast and finish the trade with Jayce E Thundering Blow/Acceleration Gate.
Urgot.fight: In cannon form, poke Urgot from outside his range, and walk away to create distance if he turns on Urgot W Purge and approaches. Right after Urgot E Disdain is down, close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies!/Shock Blast for a short trade, push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow/Acceleration Gate, then get back outside his range.
Urgot.laning: Keep the lane near the center and disrupt Urgot's last hits with cannon-form Jayce Q To the Skies!/Shock Blast. If you stay near Urgot too long, damage from his leg cannons will stack up, so don't stand close while pushing the wave all the way. If Urgot engages, switch from Jayce R Mercury Cannon to Mercury Hammer, then push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow/Acceleration Gate.
Urgot.phase: In late-game teamfights, Jayce is vulnerable if caught, so fight outside Urgot's short range.
Urgot.teamfight: Start teamfights from the back with cannon-form Jayce Q To the Skies!/Shock Blast, and watch the engage angle of Urgot E Disdain. Only go in briefly with hammer when the enemy formation is disrupted, then switch to cannon with Jayce R Mercury Cannon/Mercury Hammer and retreat. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get outside Urgot's range before reaching the execution threshold.
Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain charges in and stuns you, so avoid its engage angle and look for an opening right after he uses it. If hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, you are heavily slowed and become the target of Urgot W Purge, so decide immediately whether to dodge as it comes at you. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely outside its range before reaching the execution threshold.

Volibear.build: In the early game, hold your ground with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Volibear’s main damage is physical, and Jayce has low armor, so build armor first. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul restores the health you poke away, work Executioner's Calling into your build.
Volibear.combo: Start in Cannon stance by placing Jayce E Acceleration Gate and immediately firing Jayce Q Shock Blast through it. If you have a chance to finish him, hit with Jayce Q Shock Blast in Cannon stance, switch to Jayce R Mercury Hammer, close in with Jayce Q To the Skies!, use a basic attack and Jayce W Lightning Field, then push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow. Don’t skip the basic attack right after switching to Hammer, and plan the direction of the knockback.
Volibear.escape: After you bait out Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun, you have a chance to poke as Jayce. Look to engage only when both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and Volibear R Stormbringer are down. Use that opening to close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies! and land Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Volibear.fight: Bait out Volibear Q Thundering Smash, then poke from Cannon range. If you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, dodge to the side. When Volibear can heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, back off unless you have a clear chance to finish him. After Volibear R Stormbringer is also down, close in with Jayce Q To the Skies! and trade, then push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Volibear.laning: Keep the wave near the center and disrupt Volibear’s last hits in Cannon stance. While Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, poke with Jayce Q Shock Blast fired through Jayce E Acceleration Gate, but shorten the gap between placing the gate and firing. If Volibear gets on top of you, switch to Hammer to gain armor and push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Volibear.phase: Jayce is strongest early when he can use both forms, so build a lane advantage. In the mid game, turn that advantage into an objective lead. In late-game team fights, Jayce is at risk if caught, so poke from the back and engage briefly.
Volibear.teamfight: Start the team fight from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast, and go in briefly with Hammer only when the enemy formation is disrupted, then switch to Cannon and back away. If Volibear has built up passive stacks by attacking minions or monsters, don’t take a fight; wait for the stacks to fall off. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under your turret at low health; retreat farther inside.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed as he approaches, then stuns you, so wait it out beyond his empowered basic attack range. If you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, step to the side to avoid its damage and slow, and watch where Volibear is trying to get his shield. While Volibear R Stormbringer is available, be careful of dives even under your turret and move away from where he lands.

Yasuo.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, and Jayce has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then start your combo when Yasuo W Wind Wall won’t block it. Fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through Jayce E Acceleration Gate with a short delay, then switch between Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer to Hammer. Close in with Jayce Q To the Skies! and use a basic attack, Jayce W Lightning Field, then Jayce E Thundering Blow, planning the final knockback direction.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he has no knockup available for a while, giving you an opening to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t follow him in just because he used it once. Look for an opening before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. Then close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies!, fight, and push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before committing to a full damage trade. Poke with Jayce Q Shock Blast fired through Jayce E Acceleration Gate when Yasuo W Wind Wall is down or you can fire around it. If Yasuo gets on top of you, switch between Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer to Hammer to hold your ground, then push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Yasuo.laning: Don’t push the wave all the way; keep the wave thin and slightly toward your side near the center to limit the minion paths Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use. Keep your distance in Cannon stance and poke with Jayce Q Shock Blast while disrupting Yasuo’s last hits. Dodge Yasuo Q Steel Tempest by moving to the side, and look to trade right after he throws his tornado.
Yasuo.phase: Build a lane advantage in the early and mid game, then widen the lead through objectives. In late-game team fights, Jayce is vulnerable if caught, so poke from the back and engage briefly.
Yasuo.teamfight: Start the team fight with Jayce Q Shock Blast fired through Jayce E Acceleration Gate from the back. Go in briefly with Hammer for your combo only when the enemy formation is disrupted, then immediately switch between Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer to Cannon and back away. When Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is ready, don’t stand in its line.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to approach, so be careful with your distance where there are many minions. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, his next Q is a tornado that knocks you up, so when its stacks are full, move out of its line and dodge to the side. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, hold Jayce Q Shock Blast and look for an angle around the wall.

Yone.build: The source doesn’t specify a starting item. Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone P Way of the Hunter deal different types of damage, so don’t rely on only one resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so consider resistances and movement speed instead of stacking only health. Attack speed reduction also helps lengthen the cooldown of Yone Q Mortal Steel.
Yone.combo: In Cannon stance, poke by using Jayce E Acceleration Gate and Jayce Q Shock Blast in quick succession. When you have an opening to go in, hit Jayce Q Shock Blast, switch between Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer, then use Jayce Q To the Skies! → basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field → Jayce E Thundering Blow. Plan which way to push Yone with the final knockback.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because Yone E Soul Unbound is down; also check Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado and Yone R Fate Sealed. In particular, before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up, look for an opening when his remaining mobility is also down, then close the gap with Jayce Q To the Skies! and push him away with Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Yone.fight: While Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready, keep your distance and poke with Jayce Q Shock Blast. If Yone gets on top of you, switch between Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer to Hammer, briefly fight back with Jayce Q To the Skies! and Jayce E Thundering Blow, then push him away.
Yone.laning: In Cannon stance, disrupt last hits with Jayce Q Shock Blast, but keep the wave near the center and back away when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready.
Yone.phase: Jayce is strong early when he can use both forms, while Yone is weak early before he builds attack speed. Turn your early lane advantage into an objective lead and delay Yone’s item scaling. In the late game, Jayce is at risk if caught, so keep your engages brief.
Yone.teamfight: Poke from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast, and go in briefly only when Yone’s formation is disrupted. Keep your distance from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow, and watch your position so you don’t become an isolated backline target for Yone R Fate Sealed. After your Hammer combo, switch between Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer to Cannon and back away.
Yone.watch: When Yone Q Mortal Steel has hit minions repeatedly and its tornado is ready, back out of range to avoid his dash and knockup. Yone E Soul Unbound increases his movement speed as he dives in and deals extra damage when he returns, so if your health is low, create distance before he returns. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so stay out of his engage path.

Yorick.build: Yorick’s main damage and the Mist Walkers’ attacks deal physical damage, so hold your ground with Cloth Armor and build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites restores the health you poke away, work Executioner's Calling into your build.
Yorick.combo: In Cannon stance, place Jayce E Acceleration Gate and immediately fire Jayce Q Shock Blast through it. If you have an opening to go in, hit Jayce Q Shock Blast, switch to Jayce R Mercury Hammer, then use Jayce Q To the Skies! → basic attack → Jayce W Lightning Field → Jayce E Thundering Blow. Plan the direction so Jayce E Thundering Blow doesn’t push Yorick outside your attack range.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility, so you have an opening to engage when Yorick E Mourning Mist misses. If Yorick W Dark Procession is also down, close in with Jayce Q To the Skies!, choose which way to push Yorick with Jayce E Thundering Blow, and fight.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward and poke. Don’t start a fight where Mist Walkers have gathered; clear the Mist Walkers first. If Yorick gets on top of you, switch to Jayce R Mercury Hammer to gain armor, then fight back with Jayce Q To the Skies! and Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Yorick.laning: In Cannon stance, disrupt Yorick’s last hits with Jayce Q Shock Blast from outside his range. Graves near Yorick become his army, so push the wave to make it harder for him to clear on his side, and stay away from areas with many graves. While Yorick E Mourning Mist is missed, step forward to farm and poke.
Yorick.teamfight: Start the team fight from the back with Jayce Q Shock Blast, and go in briefly only when the enemy formation is disrupted. After your Hammer combo, switch to Jayce R Mercury Cannon and back away. If Yorick is pushing a side lane, also check whether your team can take an objective elsewhere.
Yorick.phase: Carry that advantage into objectives in the early and mid game. In the late game, Jayce is vulnerable if caught, so don’t take extended fights while marked by Yorick or surrounded by his Mist Walkers.
